_comment: Values the pre-upload scan accepts in a Playwright report. Everything else is a finding. Add an entry only for data that is demonstrably synthetic; never add a real address, host or credential. This file is reviewed like code. Names under the reserved RFC 2606 names (.example, .test, .invalid, .localhost, example.com/org/net) are always accepted. The ips listed are simulated client addresses written in tests/lockout.spec.js.
